answer.summary: The API types check failed because the generated TypeScript types are stale. The PR adds backend settings (SettingsRuntimeUpdateInput and a runtime setting type) but the committed generated types were not regenerated. The failure is deterministic and will repeat on re-run until the engineer runs yarn generate-types-from-api and commits the output.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
